title: Carnitas Tacos
description: A classic Mexican dish, our carnitas tacos feature slow-cooked pork in a flavorful mixture, served with fresh toppings.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork chunks and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, chili powder, and salt. Stir to combine.
Add enough water to the pot to cover the pork, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the pork is tender, about 2-3 hours.
Shred the pork with two forks and stir to combine with the juices.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the pork onto a tortilla, topping with chopped cilantro, and serving with Mexican crema or sour cream if desired.
